recommendation_summary: The reply recommends building the requested stack now. n8n sits at the centre and orchestrates everything. A Gmail agent watches for and extracts the yearly statement, and a Telegram bot handles confirmation, decision-day nudges and decision buttons. A vector database indexes the policy PDFs. A contract table drives events in the phone calendar on the decision day (notice deadline minus 14 days) and on the notice deadline. The reply rules out cancellation and payment. It never proposes the simpler option of just adding this year's events to the phone calendar without the stack.
note: The reply contains none of the four required labels and recommends the whole n8n, Gmail agent, Telegram bot and vector database pipeline now, even though calendar events alone would meet the user's need.
